title: Use shape to check connections
summary: Shape describes how values are arranged. For a batch, each row is one example. A layer must receive the number of features it expects.
introduction: Shape describes how values are arranged. For a batch, each row is one example. A layer must receive the number of features it expects. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain use shape to check connections
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Shape describes how values are arranged. For a batch, each row is one example. A layer must receive the number of features it expects.
The output is 3 2. There are three example rows, each with two features. A two-input layer can accept these rows.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Draw a batch with two examples and three features each.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not mix the number of examples with the number of features.
For more detail later, use this [Deep Learning further reading](https://d2l.ai/chapter_introduction/index.html).
